approach: Track a feasible fair-price interval in addition to a filtered implied-price estimate. On each new timestamp, widen the interval by estimated sigma times sqrt(elapsed); collapse it to the fee-adjusted implied price on a directional boundary-arbitrage observation; otherwise intersect it with the last quoted no-arbitrage band. Use the interval as a constraint on the adaptive fair-price estimate, then quote asymmetric fees from estimated toxicity, flow, volatility, and trade direction.
